_comment: Cernity NDR — Evidence (Elastic), portable source (Kibana saved-object NDJSON rendering is a downstream deploy step — see README.md, 'Rendering'). pcap/file drilldowns are URL drilldowns to the configured evidence gateway (evidence.base_url) with the id URL-encoded via the encodeURIComponent handlebars helper; a null id yields no navigable link. observation/flow drilldowns stay in Discover. Every pivot is an ECS field mapping back to siem_pivot.schema.json. Independently authored (§26).
title: Cernity NDR — Evidence
